Company Report
Microsoft Corporation (MSFT)
TMT: Software Largecap
Microsoft Corporation (MSFT)
Outperform | $481.63 | PT $620.00
January 29, 2026
U.S. Equity Research
Estimates Change
Good Overall Execution, Albeit with More Modest Azure Upside
MSFT reported a good overall F2Q, as total revenue of $81.3B (+15% Y/Y CC) was above
the Street's $80.3B estimate. Azure revenue grew by 38% Y/Y CC and exceeded mgmt's
guidance of ~37% Y/Y CC, but it came in slightly below buy-side expectations. Mgmt
did note that its disciplined capacity allocation weighed on Azure growth. Meanwhile,
Commercial bookings exceeded expectations, growing by a tremendous 228% Y/Y
(largely from OpenAI). Moreover, mgmt is targeting Azure revenue growth of 37-38% Y/
Y CC in F3Q, above the Street's ~36-37% projection, while MSFT's revenue guidance was
in line with consensus. MSFT also expects capex to be down sequentially.
More broadly, we remain ever-confident that MSFT's revenue growth opportunities over
the medium-term and beyond are greater than many realize, and we remain very bullish
on its tangible AI adoption and monetization levers. We reiterate our Outperform rating
and $620 PT.
Key Points
The Numbers
Total revenue of $81.3B (+17% Y/Y reported and 15% on a CC basis) was nicely above our
$80.2B forecast and the Street's similar $80.3B estimate (+15% Y/Y). This also equated
to a roughly 1.2% revenue beat, although below the average 2.4% beat over the prior
4 quarters. By segment, Intelligent Cloud (incl. Azure) and PBP exceeded expectations,
although MPC was surprisingly only roughly in line. Much more detail below.

reflect strong Azure momentum. Risks include: slower AI adoption, lagging

Microsoft Corporation
Agentic Adoption Hinges on Security; E7 SKU Presents 
$100B Upsell Opportunity
Overweight
Price Target: $615.00
  
Our Call
Leveraging its signif E3 + E5 installed base, MSFT's new E7 SKU + merchandising muscle 
could prove a catalyst for broader M365 Copilot & Agent 365 adoption into C2H26. We est 
325M seats addressable, inc. 150M M365E3/E5 or $100B potential upsell opp.
 
Initial Thoughts
Agent 365, E7 'Frontier Suite' SKU, and Copilot Wave 3: MSFT this morning announced 
a trio of M365 advancements:
1. Agent 365 announced at $15 per user per month, a control plane for managing 
agents. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
2. New E7 SKU announced at $99 per user per month, incl M365 E5, Entra Suite, 
Agent 365, and M365 Copilot. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
3. M365 Copilot Wave 3 released, built in "close collaboration" with Anthropic's Cowork.
 
 
Expect E7 bundle upsells drive M365 Copilot, Agent 365 adoption; price hikes timely:
New Agent 365 offer brings agent registry/agent ID (in Entra), observability, risk signals, 
etc.—all important prerequisites for agentic adoption. Similar to M365 Copilot, see Agent 
365 adoption as unlikely standalone (via $30/mo, $15/mo SKUs) and instead expect 
both see accelerated adoption via E7 SKU. Note: recent M365 price hikes already force 
enterprise negotiations in 2H26, creating NT adoption catalyst.
